name: sod-experiment
description: Semantic Opportunity Detector v0.1 — CONTAINED EXPERIMENT ONLY. Tests one question: can an LLM reliably perceive coaching-relevant semantic signals that the deterministic Evidence Graph representation cannot carry? SOD proposes fixed-vocabulary semantic observations traced to admitted evidence; it selects no habit, no principle, no Teaching Move, no ADVANCE/RETRY, and writes no learner-facing prose. Nothing in the repository imports this package: the structured coach's behavior is unchanged by construction.
